title: Requests and request forms are together under Client requests
description: The sidebar had a Request form row that opened a new form, next to a Requests row with your existing forms behind a button. There is now one Client requests row, with Requests and Forms under it.
items: New form is on the Forms page, so opening a page no longer starts a form
A red dot on Client requests means something is awaiting review, and the number is on Requests under it
Department admins who are not team leaders can now reach their form list. Client requests opens straight on it for them
